title: Listen to Starset’s New Song ‘ANNIHILATION,’ Debuting on Octane
summary: The new song will debut on the SiriusXM channel on September 10, with replays throughout the day.
body_markdown:
Listen to the exclusive world premiere of Starset’s new song, “ANNIHILATION,” on[Octane (Ch. 37)](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/octane) on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTheHuOctane?source=in_text) beginning at 11am ET/8am ET on Thursday, September 10. The song will then air throughout the day on the channel.


[“ANNIHILATION” World Premiere Airing on Octane starting September 10 at 11am ET Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogIceNineKillsPlayDeadOctane?source=streaming_banner)


On SiriusXM’s[Octane](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/octane) channel, you’ll experience the loud and uncensored community of new hard rock, featuring the next generation of headbangers destined to be headliners. In addition to world premieres of songs, tune in 24/7 to listen to exclusive shows, interviews with bands, Guest DJ specials, music countdowns, and more.[Stream the channel anytime on the SiriusXM app and web player](https://sxm.app.link/BlogIceNineKillsPlayDeadOctane?source=in_text) .
